title.value: Clear your inbox by voice while commuting

introduction.value: The poster built a voice assistant called April that manages email and calendar while driving or doing chores, cutting email triage from over 2 hours a day to inbox zero.

method.value: The poster built April as an iPhone voice assistant tied to Gmail and Google Calendar for times when they could not use a computer, especially while driving. By speaking commands, they could ask it to surface important emails, check whether someone replied, reschedule meetings, handle calendar conflicts, and summarize prior email threads before a meeting; the post does not describe manual review steps beyond the user issuing voice requests.

outcome.value: They say it cut their email triage from more than two hours a day to reaching inbox zero, after missing a meeting update in a crowded inbox. They also say it is not perfect and expect voice-AI edge cases.

notes.value: It was iPhone-only at the time, worked with Gmail plus Google Calendar, and the poster said trying it was about a 15-minute setup.

source_text.body:
Clear your inbox by voice while commuting
The poster built a voice assistant called April that manages email and calendar while driving or doing chores, cutting email triage from over 2 hours a day to inbox zero.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The poster built April as an iPhone voice assistant tied to Gmail and Google Calendar for times when they could not use a computer, especially while driving. By speaking commands, they could ask it to surface important emails, check whether someone replied, reschedule meetings, handle calendar conflicts, and summarize prior email threads before a meeting; the post does not describe manual review steps beyond the user issuing voice requests.
How it went
They say it cut their email triage from more than two hours a day to reaching inbox zero, after missing a meeting update in a crowded inbox. They also say it is not perfect and expect voice-AI edge cases.
Worth knowing
It was iPhone-only at the time, worked with Gmail plus Google Calendar, and the poster said trying it was about a 15-minute setup.
Try it yourself
with
Lindy
Copy prompt
Create a voice-friendly assistant that I can talk to while [driving or doing chores] to handle my [Gmail or Outlook] inbox and calendar. It should read me a summary of new emails, draft replies from my dictated instructions, archive low-priority mail, and propose calendar changes. Pause and read back any email or calendar invite before sending it, and never delete anything without my confirmation. You're done when I can get through my inbox to zero by voice.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ProductivityApps/comments/1p5zduo/giveaway_built_a_voice_ai_assistant_to_clear_my
